name: Held As
description: This file, observed on a host, has a copy held in TAP's file store as this tap_file (core's type, tap req-tap-files-node). Written only when TAP holds a copy, so an instance with no file store never has one (ruled 2026-11-19). At most one per file; the grid cannot yet refuse a second (tap#1237), so the writer keeps to one.
